groups.name: Oceans and Continents
cards: How much of Earth is covered by water?
Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, Australia
The ocean named after a country
Mariana Trench, about 11 km down, in the Pacific

groups.name: Land Forms and Life
cards: High, flat-topped land, like a table
The highest plateau in the world
Tibetan Plateau, the "roof of the world"
Why are plateaus important for industry?
They are rich in minerals like coal and iron.
A fertile, crowded plain in north India
Landform that supports the most people
Why do mountains have few people?
Steep, cold, and little flat land for farming

groups.name: Timeline and Sources of History
cards: Which is earlier: 300 BCE or 100 BCE?
About 600 (different sides of year 1, so add)
A century, a decade, a millennium
Who digs up and studies old objects?
Writing carved on stone, metal or walls (Ashoka's edicts)
A handwritten book, such as on palm leaf or birch bark
From the time itself (a coin, an old letter)
Written later about that time (a textbook)

groups.name: Grassroots Democracy
cards: The three tiers of Panchayati Raj, village to district
Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti, Zila Parishad
Gram Sabha: who is in it?
All the adult voters of the village
Voting age, and term of office
Share of seats reserved for women
Local taxes and grants from the State and Union governments
Name three jobs of a Gram Panchayat
Any three: drinking water, roads, street lights, sanitation, schools
Sabha: all voters meeting. Panchayat: the elected body that runs the village.

groups.name: Economic Activities Around Us
cards: Taking things from nature: farming, fishing, mining
Making goods from raw materials: factories, building
Services: teaching, medicine, shops, transport, banking
Goods or service: a loaf of bread
Need or want: food and water
Most villagers do which kind of work?
Producer makes goods or gives a service. Consumer uses them.
